headline: Share what matters. Keep what matters.
keyMessage: Share & Learn isn't meant to replace the places where we already talk and share. It's a place for the things we don't want to lose.
problem: Conversations move on. Useful links get buried. Recipes, songs, documents, ideas and experiences become difficult to find again.
purpose: Share & Learn gives those things a home where they can be preserved, organized, shared and rediscovered.

flow.line: what you don't want to lose
in a way that makes sense

why.heading: Why Share & Learn
paragraphs: We share useful and meaningful things every day—songs, recipes, books, remedies, links, ideas and experiences. But over time, they get buried in messages and become difficult to find.
Share & Learn gives those things a place to stay, while keeping them connected to the people and conversations that give them meaning.

points.title: Share within Circles
points.copy: Share with family, friends or communities you belong to.

points.title: Organize naturally
points.copy: Use folders and subfolders when you need them.

points.title: Keep the details
points.copy: Songs, recipes, books and other kinds of content can keep the information that matters to them.

points.title: Learn from each other
points.copy: Discussions, experiences and tips stay connected to what was shared.

points.title: Find it again
points.copy: Browse, search or save things to your library for later.

communities.heading: Built around communities
paragraphs: Every Circle is different. A family may share recipes and memories, a music group may share songs, and a learning community may share books, articles and ideas.
Each Circle can choose what it wants to share and organize that knowledge in the way that works for its community.

closing: Keep talking and sharing wherever you already do.
When something is worth keeping, give it a place in Share & Learn.
